themes.name: Grassland
themes.blurb: Open fields, gentle rises and scattered copses. Long sight lines favour long-range guns.

themes.name: Woodland
themes.blurb: Thick forest broken by clearings. Woods block sight and cost MP, so fights happen close.

themes.name: Hills
themes.blurb: Steep ridges and valleys. High ground gives partial cover and longer views.

themes.name: River Valley
themes.blurb: A river winds through low farmland. Water slows movement but cools a 'Mech standing in it.

themes.name: Lake Country
themes.blurb: Lakes and marshy shores. Deep water hides a 'Mech's legs but can flood a breached hull.

themes.name: Badlands
themes.blurb: Dry broken ground and rocky mesas with almost no trees. Rough hexes cost MP but give no cover.

themes.name: City
themes.blurb: Streets between blocks of buildings. Buildings block sight and can be entered, shot or toppled.

themes.name: Open Plains
themes.blurb: Low rises and scattered copses create long firing lanes, with isolated covered approaches.

themes.name: Heavy Forest
themes.blurb: A dense forest with clearings and narrow road approaches. Fast and jumping units have more options, but slow units need to plan their routes.

themes.name: Desert Hills
themes.blurb: Bare hills and ridges provide elevation cover with little rough ground or vegetation.
